title: 3.0.0.1 dev-h - Not tracking BG and IOB properly
body:
Reporting bugs
--------------
- 16:30ish - April 3rd- after updating from Tim's dev to NSDev-H I wasn't able to use Dynamic ISF because "no glucose data available". BYODA is working fine and the current BG is showing up in AAPS but AAPS doesn't seem to be logging BG data or IOB data as there are no graphs at all. IOB and COB are totally wrong. Its not logging carbs that I enter. When I manually gave insulin it worked but it actually subtracted insulin from the IOB and it subtracted the wrong amount. 
- Samsung S9
- 
I re-installed Tim's Dev and Master 3 and they are both working fine. 
-
